kicker: Extra! Extra! Week 1 is in the ground
headline: Brawl Outside the Silver Goon Saloon Leaves Main Street in Splinters. Gopher Gold the Last Man Standing.
deck: The player piano started on Tuesday like it always does. By Sunday a chair had gone through the front window, the defending champ was face down in the horse trough, and one regular never got off his barstool.
hero_caption: Main Street outside the Silver Goon, as sketched by our correspondent from underneath the boardwalk.

chapters.head: Another Tuesday in Goon Gulch
text: Every Tuesday morning Goon Gulch wakes up the same way. The player piano strikes up the same tune, the bartender wipes the same glass, and twelve outfits push through the batwing doors with the same plan they had last season. Nobody in town remembers how the week ends. Nobody ever does.

This week the clockwork slipped. John J came in through the side door with a coat full of roster moves. Roshan burst in at closing time Sunday and bought three rounds before the bartender could turn around. Sagar sat down on the same barstool he took Tuesday morning and did not move again.
Then somebody threw a chair through the front window, and the whole saloon spilled into the street.

chapters.head: Wanted Posters on the Sheriff's Door
chapters.sub: Nailed up before the dust settled.

chapters.head: Six Duels on Main Street
chapters.caption: The batwing doors of the Silver Goon, shortly before a patron removed them on his way through.
text: Six duels broke out in the street, one for every two outfits in town. Here is who was still standing when the sheriff finally came out with a lantern.
The champ's pistol jammed in the first round, Acinonyx cleaned out the poker table, and BrookynDynasty landed more punches than almost anybody and still ended up in the trough.

chapters.head: The Fight Rolls Into the Weekend
chapters.caption: The player piano, which kept playing through all of it.
text: Most fights on Main Street are over by Friday. Four of these were still rolling around in the dirt when the church bell rang on Sunday.

chapters.head: The Undertaker Takes Measurements
chapters.caption: The undertaker, reached for comment, asked to be paid in advance.
text: The undertaker worked a double shift. Jalen Williams went down on the last day of the week and is laid out in Parth's back room. Cooper Flagg, the priciest horse at the spring auction, is in Keshav's stable with a question mark nailed to the stall door. Stephen Curry is sleeping it off in John J's infirmary.
Worst of all, Zero Fox Given walked into Monday with two men the undertaker has already measured standing in the starting lineup, boots on, eyes closed.

chapters.head: The Long Ride Out of Goon Gulch
chapters.caption: The posse, departing Monday with the assayer's report and a bad map.
text: The posse saddled up Monday with the assayer's report in one hand and the odds in the other. Gopher Gold leads the ride, but the assayer ranks their claim only ninth in the territory, which is exactly how fool's gold looks right before somebody bites it.

White Mambas, the old prospector with no moves and a losing record, is sitting on the richest vein in the hills and refuses to tell anyone. Zero Fox Given's claim is a hole in the ground with a tumbleweed in it.

chapters.head: Overheard at the Bar
chapters.sub: Mumbled into the sawdust after last call.

mvp.title: Sheriff
mvp.line: Threw the first punch, the last punch and most of the ones in between. Sabonis did the heavy lifting and most of the rebounding.
mvp.reward: A tin star, two ponies, and the deed to a gold claim nobody has checked for rattlesnakes

dud.title: Dead Weight
dud.line: Sat on the same barstool from the first song to the last. Has not filed one claim with the land office.
dud.reward: One mule with a limp, a sack of beans, and a free exorcism from the traveling tent preacher

luckiest.title: Horse Thief
luckiest.line: Rode a mule in the Derby and won by a length. Somebody check his saddlebags. And his sleeves.
luckiest.reward: A mail-order bride from Boston who has never seen a horse, and a one-way ticket on the next stagecoach out

robbed.title: Bushwhacked
robbed.line: Outdrew most of the gunslingers in the street, then took a chair across the back from the Sheriff on his way out.
robbed.reward: A new hat with fewer holes, and a sympathy pie from the widow who runs the boarding house

web.l.39751.t.5|web.l.39751.t.8.text: Suggs had MONSTARS pinned against the bar on Friday. MONSTARS broke loose Saturday and stood on a table to celebrate. Sunday, Scottie Barnes swung at everything in the room and connected with nothing. Both outfits woke up Monday on the same floor.

web.l.39751.t.7|web.l.39751.t.10.text: White Mambas sent Jamal Murray crashing back through the doors on the weekend, swinging a bottle at anybody. Nova Knicks had already paid the tab and gone home.

web.l.39751.t.1|web.l.39751.t.12.text: theInfamous was face down in the sawdust by Friday and got one good kick in from the floor. Adam Silver Dez Nuts stepped over him on the way out.

web.l.39751.t.2|web.l.39751.t.11.text: Acinonyx had the fight won by Thursday. On Sunday Luka went back inside anyway, ordered a whiskey, and took every chip on the table.

zingers.web.l.39751.t.1: Made more moves than anyone in town. Darius Acuff Jr. took more shots than the whole O.K. Corral.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.2: Plays cards like a man with a derringer in his boot. Vučević started once and contributed about as much as a scarecrow in a duster.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.3: Paying rent on two infirmary cots for men who haven't seen daylight all season. The boarding house loves him.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.4: Struck gold and is already building a second saloon. Sabonis shot like the hoop was a water trough.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.5: Two moves all week, same as the town drunk, and the same result: a tie with the hitching post.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.6: Cut De'Anthony Melton after one cold night. Jason picked him up, got a big night, and ran him out of town too.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.7: His waiver strategy is a man firing a scattergun at a barn and calling whatever he hits a plan.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.8: Paid thoroughbred money for a horse who spent half the week in the barn. Still dragged the wagon to a tie.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.9: The champ's badge is already tarnished, and Kon Knueppel has yet to leave the infirmary cot.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.10: Sat on the porch with a rifle across his lap and never got up. Josh Giddey rode drag all week, eating everybody's dust.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.11: The piano player has made more roster moves, and the piano player is a piano.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.12: A decent card player at a table full of drunks. Enjoy the pot. The sober ones show up eventually.

sign_off: Next Monday, the Gazette goes undercover. Trust nobody in a tuxedo.
